The 2-hydroxy- morpholine derivatives 3, 6 and 10 are synthesised by the reaction of the appropriate aminoalcohol (22 mmol) and the 2-bromo-4-phenylacetophenone or the 2-bromoacetophenone (10 mmol) in ether and acetone for 15 hours at room temperature. The 2-alkoxy derivatives 1, 4 and 7 are synthesised by the reaction of the respective 2-hydroxy derivative with the appropriate alcohol, in acid medium and reflux. Compounds 2, 5, 8 and 9 are synthesised by the reaction of the respective 2-hydroxy derivative with the 3-bromopropanol in acidic medium and reflux. The 2-(3-bromopropoxy) derivatives then reacted with silver nitrate in acetonitrile and reflux. The compounds of formula (I) decrease significantly total cholesterol, triglyceride and LDL-cholesterol levels in plasma. The compounds of formula (I) possess potent antioxidant activity. The compounds of formula (I) with the above properties could be useful to the treatment of hypercholesterolemia, hyperlipidemia and atheromatosis.

The invention relates to a rhododendron micranthum turcz compound extraction method, belongs to the technical field of medicine, and particularly relates to a rhododendron micranthum turcz compound extraction method. The rhododendron micranthum turcz compound extraction method comprises: (1) taking 20-40 kg of dried rhododendron micranthum turcz branches and leaves, carrying out cold leaching extraction three times with 95% ethanol, wherein the soaking time is one week each time; (2) carrying out gradient elution on the ethyl acetate part through normal phase silica gel column chromatography with chloroform-methanol (50:1-2:1) to obtain 10 components; (3) dissolving the component B with methanol, filtering, washing the filtered solid to obtain a compound 6, separating the filtrate into three sub-components through a gel chromatography column, and purifying the sub-component B2 through normal phase silica gel column chromatography and HPLC at a speed of 1.5 mL/min to obtain a compound 8; (4) loading the sub-component B3 onto reverse phase silica gel column chromatography with 30% methanol to obtain a compound 5, loading the component C onto reverse phase silica gel column 70 chromatography with 30% methanol and gel column chromatography with methanol to obtain compounds 1 and 7; and (5) loading the component D onto gel column chromatography with methanol, and purifying through HPLC with 60% methanol at a speed of 1.5 mL/min to obtain a compound 10.

The invention relates to a 5-carboxylic acid indolinone preparation method, belongs to the technical field of medicine, and particularly relates to a 5-carboxylic acid indolinone preparation method. The present invention provides a 5-carboxylic acid indolinone preparation method with characteristics of simple operation and environmental protection. The 5-carboxylic acid indolinone preparation method comprises: (1) adding 9.0 g of trichloroacetaldehyde and 120 mL of water to a 250 mL three-necked flask having a dropping funnel and a thermometer, uniformly stirring, and sequentially adding 65 g of anhydrous sodium sulfate; (2) adding 32.6 mL of concentrated sulfuric acid to the 250 mL three-necked flask, heating to a temperature of 50 DEG C, and adding 9.2 g of a compound 2 in a batch manner under stirring, wherein the adding rate is controlled to make the temperature be at 60-70 DEG C; (3) adding a compound 3 to a 500 mL three-necked flask, adding 25 mL of 80% hydrazine hydrate, adding 25 mL of water, tracking the reaction with TLC until achieving the end point, cooling to a room temperature, adding concentrated hydrochloric acid to achieve the pH value of less than 3, stirring for 12 h at a temperature of 50 DEG C, filtering, and carrying out water washing to obtain the pale yellow solid 5-formic acid-indolin-2-one, wherein the mp: is more than 300 DEG C.

The synthesis steps comprise: adding a compound ethyl 2-(2-aminothiazole-4-yl)-2-(1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-1-methylethoxyimino)acetate to a 4-necked flask with a condensation pipe and mechanical stirring, wherein a reaction solvent is a methanol and water mixing solvent, and a volume ratio of methanol to water is 3:1-1-:3; adding NaOH, wherein a molar ratio of the ethyl 2-(2-aminothiazole-4-yl)-2-(1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-1-methylethoxyimino)acetate to the NaOH is 1:1-1:2; stirring at a temperature of 15-60 DEG C; adding 2 g of active carbon, stirring for 1 h, and filtering to remove insoluble substance; cooling the filtrate to a temperature of 20 DEG C, and adjusting the pH value to 7 with 1 mol/L hydrochloric acid; and carrying out pressure reducing distillation at a temperature of 40-45 DEG C to recover methanol, dissolving the remaining material in 75 ml of water, adjusting the pH value to 3 with 1 mol/L hydrochloric acid, carrying out suction filtration, washing the filter cake sequentially with 50 mL of water and 50 mL of acetonitrile, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the pale yellow solid.

The invention provides bathing powder with efficacies of relaxing tendons and activating collaterals and containing vittaria nana and a preparation method of the bathing powder. The bathing powder comprises a medicinal powder bag and a spice bag. The medicinal powder bag is prepared from the following medicinal materials in parts by weight: 35-45 parts of vittaria nana, 10-16 parts of seeds of Amygdalus communis L., 10-16 parts of twig and leaf of creeping psychotria, 5-8 parts of root of Ophiorrhiza succirubra King, 5-8 parts of dried mussels, 5-8 parts of Silene songarica (Fisc, Mey.etAve-Lael) Bocquct [Melandriumbrachypetalum (Horn.)Fenzl.], 5-8 parts of all-grass of shrubberry rhodiola, 3-6 parts of damnacanthus indicus flowers, 3-6 parts of cotton rose hibiscus leaf, 3-6 parts of root or all-grass of Stachys palustris L., and 3-6 parts of flowers of Chinese globeflower. The spice bag is prepared from the following medicinal materials in parts by weight: 10-12 parts of rose flowers, 8-10 parts of China rose flowers, 6-8 parts of seville orange flowers, 3-5 parts of flos caryophylli, and 3-5 parts of lavender. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing the medicinal powder bag, which comprises the following substeps: A, pretreating the raw materials, B, soaking, drying by steaming, cutting up and baking, C, extracting a filtrate, D, carrying out centrifugal separation, and mixing the solutions, and E, concentrating and drying; (2) preparing the spice bag; and (3) packaging the medicinal powder bag and the spice bag into a packaging bag, thus obtaining the finished product. The bathing powder has the efficacies of relaxing tendons and activating collaterals, dispelling wind and eliminating dampness, as well as relieving swelling and pain after being used for a long term.

The invention discloses a smelting process of wheel steel, which comprises the steps of putting blast furnace molten iron with the sulfur content of less than or equal to 10ppm after desulfurization into a converter for smelting, controlling the temperature in the smelting process of the converter to be more than or equal to 1660 ℃, carrying out whole-process bottom argon blowing on the molten steel by argon of 300 to 400m 3/h, carrying out whole-process bottom argon blowing by adopting silicon and manganese alloy for composite deoxidation, tapping after the alloy content in the molten steel reaches the standard, sending the molten steel to an argon blowing station for argon blowing treatment, and carrying out 1565 to 1550 ℃ when the molten steel is discharged from the argon blowing station, molten steel is sent to LF to be refined, Mn, Si, Al, Nb and Ti alloys are added into the molten steel, the molten steel refining time is 70 to 80min, and the binary alkalinity in slag is more than or equal to 1.0. The argon gas flow of the stopper rod and the argon gas flow of the long nozzle are respectively more than or equal to 6L/min < b > and 2L/min < b >, and the overheating temperature of the molten steel is 15-30 ℃. The production cost of the wheel steel provided by the smelting process is reduced by 30 percent to 50 percent, the bending fatigue times of the spoke and the radial fatigue times of the rim reach more than 10 ten thousand, and the wheel steel can be used for manufacturing wheels with or without inner tubes. The invention provides a device and a method for removing dust of a boiler. A traditional device for removing dust of a boiler is complicated in structure, water resources are wasted, the dust removing effect is not good, and the atmosphere is polluted. The device for removing the dust of the boiler comprises a motor, and is characterized in that a motor (1) is connected with a circulating pump (17); the circulating pump (17) is connected with a water feeding tube assembly (2); the water feeding tube assembly (2) is connected with a water feeding transverse tube assembly (5), the water feeding transverse tube (5) is connected with a water tank (8); a tube joint (6) is arranged between the water feeding transverse tube (5) and the water tank (8); the water tank is connected with a water draining tube (16); the water draining tube (16) is connected with the circulating pump (17); the water tank (8) is connected with a discharging tube assembly (14); a discharging hole is formed on the lower part of the discharging tube assembly (14); the water tank (8) is connected with a smoke inlet (15); and the water tank is connected with a smoke outlet (13). The device and the method for removing dust of the boiler are used for removing dust of the boiler.

The invention relates to a positive electrode material for a lithium battery, which is represented by a chemical general formula LixM 1-xFePO 4, wherein M is selected from Mg < 2+ >, Ca < 2+ >, Sr < 2+ >, Ti < 3+ >, Al < 3+ >, B < 3+ >, Si < 4+ >, Ge < 4+ >, P < 5+ >. The material is prepared by adding a conductive dopant, and heating to 500-900 ℃ to react for 10 hours by adopting metal oxide, carbonate, sulfide, phosphate, fluoride and unsaturated lithium iron phosphate crystal. The lithium iron phosphate crystal with high conductivity can be prepared by a non-stoichiometric method, and the material of the lithium iron phosphate crystal is represented by a chemical general formula LiFePO 4-y. For preparing the anode material of the lithium battery by the supercharged replacement ions, the chemical general formula is Li < x > M < 1-x > Fe < z > M '1-z > PO 4, M' is selected from Ti < 3+ >, V < 3+ >, Co < 3+ >, Ni < 3+ >, Mn < 3+ >, Cr < 3+ >, Cu < 3+ > and Mo < 3+ >, solid powder of magnesium-doped lithium iron manganese phosphate LixMg 1-xFezMn 1-zPO 4 is prepared through solid phase reaction. The cathode material with the nano structure has a chemical general formula of LixFePO 4-y, and is prepared by vacuum sputtering deposition, the conductivity of the material can reach 10< -2 > S/cm, and the actual discharge capacity can reach 240 mAh/g. The novel anode material has the characteristics of low price, high energy and safety, and is not only suitable for medium and small polymer, colloid and liquid lithium ion batteries, but also particularly suitable for high-power batteries.

The invention discloses a two-component automobile-hub rapid mending agent. The two-component automobile-hub rapid mending agent comprises components A and components B. The components A comprise, by weight, 17.7% to 33.2% of modified epoxy resin, 4.3% to 12.3% of multifunctional epoxy resin and 45.5% to 78% of kaolin. The components B comprise, by weight, 5.3% to 9.4% of phosphorus-containing curing agents, 1.2% to 2.1% of nitrogen-containing curing agents, 0.1% to 0.4% of curing accelerants, 40.4% to 66.1% of kaolin and 27.3% to 47.7% of carbon aluminum alloy powder. Before mending is carried out, the components A and the components B are mixed according to the weight ratio of 1.1-1.7 to 1 for use. The two-component automobile-hub rapid mending agent is reasonable in component, environmentally friendly, simple in mending technology and capable of being rapidly formed; the two-component automobile-hub rapid mending agent can be formed after being baked for at least fifteen minutes at the temperature of 80 DEG C to 100 DEG C, rigidity is quite high, the automobile-hub mending cost can be effectively reduced, and the remarkable economic benefits and the remarkable social benefits are achieved.

The calcium magnesium segment difference molten steel filter dam comprises, by weight percentage, 10-20%, 20-30% and 15-25% of calcium sand particles with the diameters of 10-5mm, 5-3mm and 3-1mm respectively, 15-25% of waste magnesia-calcium brick sand with the diameter less than 1mm, 14-18% of 200 mesh waste magnesia-calcium brick sand or fused magnesite fine powder, and 2-6% of phenolic resin. According to the calcium magnesium segment difference molten steel filter dam manufactured by the raw materials through a casting method, hydrating prevention capacity is high, retention time is long, manufacturing is easy, production cost is low, a filtering contact area is increased in structure, filtering contact time is prolonged, and therefore filtering efficiency is improved, and the purity of molten steel obtained through the filter dam is greatly improved compared with that of molten steel obtained through an existing calcium filter.

The invention discloses a pig IFITM3 gene for inhibiting mouth disease virus multiplication, and a construction method and an application. The method comprises the following steps of: A, synthesizing pig IFITM3 genes: designing primers, extracting pig lymphoid tissue RNA, carrying out RT-PCR multiplication on sIFITM3 genes, carrying out multiplication, using pCA-sIFITM3 for realizing transfection on BHK-21 cells and observing the protein to be expressed on the cell membrane through a confocal microscopy; B, constructing and purifying the slow virus for expressing the sIFITM3 genes; and C, constructing the BHK21-sIFITM3eGFP cell systems for stably expressing the sIFITM3 genes: constructing the BHK-21 cell systems for stabilizing the sIFITM3 genes, using Lentivirus-sIFITM3eGFP and LentiviruseGFP for respectively realizing the transfection on the BHK-21 cells, carrying out cloning screening by green fluorescence and identifying the expression of the sIFITM3 being BHK21-sIFITM3eGFP through RT-PCR and Westernblotting. The invention also discloses the application of the gene, the cell system BHK21-sIFITM3eGFP, the slow virus Lentivirus-sIFITM3 and the eukaryotic plasmid pCA-sIFITM3 to the preparation of medicine for treating or preventing the mouth disease virus. The constructed BHK21-sIFITM3eGFP cell systems can stably express sIFITM3 protein, BHK21-sIFITM3eGFP can inhibit the copying of the mouth disease virus, and the slow virus lentivirus-sIFITM3 carrying sIFITM3 and the eukaryotic plasmid pCA-sIFITM3 can inhibit the copying of the mouth disease virus at the organism level.

The invention provides a coking wastewater treatment apparatus and method. The apparatus includes a regulation pool (1); the regulation pool is connected with a suction well A (2); the suction well A is connected to a gravity degreasing pool (3); the gravity degreasing pool is connected to a suction well B (4); the suction well B is connected to a flotation degreasing tank (5); the flotation degreasing tank is connected to a suction well C (6); the suction well C is connected to an anaerobic pool (7); the anaerobic pool is connected to a suction well D (8); the suction well D is connected to anoxic pool (9); the anoxic pool is connected to an aerobic pool (10); the aerobic pool is connected to a secondary sedimentation tank (11); the secondary sedimentation tank is connected to a mixed reaction pool (12); and the mixed reaction pool is connected to a mixed coagulation sedimentation tank (13). The invention is used for coking wastewater treatment.

The invention discloses a cone-type mold for compression molding of solids and an application method of the cone-shaped mold. The invention relates to a preparation method for 2-chloro-2-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane, and belongs to the technical field of phosphorus-containing organic compound intermediate preparation. The method comprises the following steps: A) preparation of 2-chloro-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane: ethylene glycol reacts with phosphorus trichloride in an organic solvent system to generate 2-chloro-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane; B) preparation of 2-chloro-2-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane: the 2-chloro-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane is subjected to an oxidizing reaction in an organic solvent with dried ozone, then the organic solvent is removed, and the fraction is collected by vacuum rectification to obtain the 2-chloro-2-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane. The method has the following advantages that: the ozone is adopted during the preparation process of the target product 2-chloro-2-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane so as to substantially improve the oxidation capacity, such that the yield is 59-80%, and the method has the value of the industrialized enlarged production, wherein the resulting 2-chloro-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane from the step A) is subjected to the step B) to obtain the target product 2-chloro-2-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaphospholane.
